title: Request a JMS reply on a caller-owned queue
summary: An embedded Artemis responder acknowledged both object- and name-addressed requests through the caller's reply queue. An independent exchange on the same queue then delivered C.

change.description: JmsOperations and JmsTemplate gain sendAndReceive overloads taking explicit request and reply destinations or their names. The caller can retain the reply destination across calls.

notes: The existing overload returned its acknowledgement via a temporary queue on both revisions. The broker ran in-process with finite receives and one outstanding request.

Spring JMS 7.0.4 applies a correlation selector to the caller-owned queue. Uncorrelated replies remained there, and the same caller timed out. Copying the assigned message ID or an explicit request correlation ID into each reply restored ack-A, ack-B, and the subsequent marker C on Artemis.
